# `server info`

Get initialization info for a connected server.

```bash theme={"theme":"css-variables"}
mcpjam server i

nfo --url https://your-server.com/mcp --access-token $TOKEN
```

Returns the server's `serverInfo` (name, version) and `capabil

ities` from the MCP initialize response.
